```plato
// Path-tracing quality controls. SamplesPerPixel and MaxBounces bound the
// integration work; RadianceClamp caps per-sample radiance to suppress
// fireflies (0 = unclamped); Seed makes runs reproducible.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Path_tracing)
type PathTracingSettings
    implements IValue
{
    SamplesPerPixel: Integer;
    MaxBounces: Integer;
    RadianceClamp: Number;
    Denoiser: Denoiser;
    Seed: Integer;
}
```
